5.title: Offer expiry enforcement
5.body: **User story** — As a shopper, expired offers never apply.
5.author: paul

comments.author: paul
comments.body:
**[reviewer] · should-fix · boundary**

`return sum(i.cost for i in cart if not i.offer or i.offer.expires_at >= now)` — an offer expiring exactly now is still applied; spec R4 says past `expires_at` is excluded, so `>=` is right — name the boundary.
